items.name: Save and tag a link
items.outcome: The link is durably saved in the user's library and retrievable by each tag they added.
steps: Paste or type the URL into the single save field and press Save.
See the link appear at the top of the library immediately, with the page title resolved.
Type one or two tags into the link's tag field and confirm.
items.trigger: WHEN the collector finds a URL worth keeping and opens Linkbox to save it.

items.name: Publish and share a collection
items.outcome: Anyone with the share link can read the collection while it is published, and loses access the moment the curator revokes it.
steps: Open the collection and add the saved links that belong in it.
Press Publish to generate a read-only share link.
Copy the share link and hand it to the audience; later, press Revoke to take it down.
items.trigger: WHEN the curator has gathered a themed set of links and wants to share just that set.
